note: Corps of Engineers campground at the north end of Cold Brook Lake, under a mile north of Hot Springs, with a camp host. Sites 12 and 13 sit by the water; the rest are on an open loop a short walk away. The 33-acre lake allows only paddle craft and electric motors; a boat ramp, swim beach, picnic shelters, archery range and playground are in the recreation area. Drinking water in season only. --Claude

Stored evidence describes only the main loop ('300-400 m N of the reservoir') and misses these two sites - candidate for lakefront with a caveat naming sites 12 and 13.
